description: What the owner can open and try after every build section. tools/showcase.py turns this file, the visuals index, the catalog and tools/blueprint_numbers.py into one offline page (web/showcase/dist/lynkomni-showcase.html). Emulator links point at the private pages Claude publishes after each section; update the link when a page is republished under a new address.

sections.title: Business app and the whole of LynkPOS
LynkAcc, LynkInv, LynkCRM, LynkStat and LynkOps
Customer app, shop pages and pay pages

emulators.title: LynkOmni Account site
emulators.what: Sign-up in four steps, sign-in with a passkey, the three recovery paths, Security Center and every account page. Computer, tablet and phone.
emulators.try: Tap Create account and go through the four steps; then Recover your account and answer the two questions.

emulators.title: Shared shell (browser frame)
emulators.what: The frame every LynkOmni screen sits in: header, navigation, launcher, search, help, notifications, connection and sync states, overlays, dark, lite and sunlight modes.
emulators.try: Switch size, language and mode at the top; open the launcher and the notifications panel.

emulators.title: Business app on a merchant's phone
emulators.what: Selling, money, stock, customers and chat on a phone, including offline states. Built before the shell; section 3 brings it onto the shell and the account rules.
emulators.try: Make a sale and watch its state: queued, sent, accepted, confirmed.

emulators.title: LynkPOS handheld terminal
emulators.what: A physical terminal: screen, keypad, card tap area, receipt printer that prints, scanner and cash drawer, running on sandbox adapters. Section 3 completes it.
emulators.try: Ring up items on the keypad, tap a card, print the receipt.
